messages:
Alex: Quick question for the internet  if semver and YAML went on a blind date, who would cause the awkward silence first? :thinking_face:
Priya: YAML. Its like, 'I love you' then a rogue space ruins everything. :sweat_smile:
Jordan: semver would overanalyze the menu. "Is this a breaking change or just a spicy minor?" :joy:
Sam: Real conversation: I merged a YAML change that removed a dash. Prod said no thanks.
build-bot: CI: :rotating_light: config-lint failed on config/service.yaml: unexpected mapping key at line 34
Alex: Here's the offending snippet:
```yaml
notifications:
  providers:
    - name: email
      enabled: true
     - name: slack
       enabled: true
```
Priya: Oof that hyphen alignment looks like modern art. linter reveals truth. :paintbrush:
Jordan: Also semver's on the phone with customer support asking for a rollback plan. :telephone_receiver:
Sam: Proposal: Any YAML PR that contains more than one list item gets a mandatory reviewer who speaks fluent whitespace.
Alex: I second. Also will trademark the policy: "Whitespace Guardian" v0.1.0
Priya: Do we version office policies with semver now? Danger zone. :sweat_smile:
Jordan: Only if we avoid versioning the coffee machine. Last time it hit v3.0.0 the espresso started steaming differently. :coffee:
Sam: New office rule: if your config breaks CI, you owe the team doughnuts. High incentive to lint. :doughnut:
build-bot: :white_check_mark: lint step added to CI for this repo. First-time offenders will receive automated pity messages.
Alex: Also, meme someone made: "YAML and semver at the same table" (imagine three-way stare). Link: https://imgur.com/fake-meme-url :rofl:
Priya: saving that one for onboarding slides.
Jordan: can we get a sticker that says "I Lint My YAML"? I'd slap that on my laptop.
Sam: +1. Also can we make semver sign a consent form before changing majors at 2am?
Alex: Done. Adding to handbook as a joke entry (and also adding linter requirement). :memo:
build-bot: Archiving thread under random/memes. Tagging with :yaml: and :semver:.
